title: Less work at startup. Shared work on iOS.
eyebrow: Wisconsin Creative · Web + iOS · Local performance pass
lede: Measured improvements to shared startup, optional dialogs, API decoding and image loading. Existing behavior and work are preserved; authenticated and physical-device measurements remain a separate gate.

stats.n: Five repeated trials; the subtree now mounts once.
Downloads and image objects for 24 rows sharing one image.
Verified with real response decoding; total CPU is not reduced.

changes.h: Eight routes carry less startup JavaScript
changes.was: The shared shell eagerly included optional profile form and badge code.
changes.now: On-demand loading lowers initial gzip bytes by / 9.4%; /items 6.6%; /bookings 6.9%; /schedule 3.6%; /reservations/new 3.9%; /users 7.7%; /resources 6.6%; /signatures 4.7%. These are build measurements, not page-load latency.

changes.h: One page mount through cache restoration
changes.was: The provider changed type after mounting. Cold and corrupt-cache fixtures issued two query requests and two effect requests.
changes.now: One mount and one of each request. A fresh persisted dashboard needs zero query requests. Denied storage safely uses memory. All 20 browser trials passed.

changes.was: 24 simultaneous cold-cache consumers created 24 requests and 24 decoded images in the fixture.
changes.now: One request and one shared image. Tests cover size/scale, one-row and all-row cancellation, retry, and sign-out isolation. This is a request/allocation reduction, not a physical-device scrolling claim.

changes.h: API decoding leaves the UI thread
changes.was: Median synchronous decoding occupied the main actor for 0.259 ms at 30 assets, 2.457 ms at 300, and 23.967 ms at the 3,000-row stress size.
changes.now: Thread-probe tests confirm off-main decoding. Total medians are 0.296 / 2.590 / 25.290 ms; overall CPU work is not reduced. The client rechecks account ownership and cancellation before publication.

changes.was: Median Debug simulator launch 2.212 s; Items CPU 1.028 s; equipment CPU 0.931 s.
changes.now: Launch 2.166 s; Items CPU 1.020 s; equipment CPU 0.944 s. Ranges overlap. No broad launch/scroll improvement is claimed; these fixtures bypass the optimized decoding and images.

verification: Full web suite: 5,019 passing tests and one existing skip. Production app builds and final TypeScript check passed.
Final native unit run: 93 XCTest + 93 Swift Testing cases passed. Three before/after interaction benchmarks passed on iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27.0.
Unsigned generic-iOS Release build and XcodeGen consistency check passed. Affected Swift source-contract tests passed.
Focused lint on changed files passed. Full lint still fails on the unchanged vendored QR library at public/qrcode/vendor/jsQR.js:23.
Raw JSON samples, source provenance and review receipts are retained beside this page; full build/test logs remain in the private .tmp benchmark directory.
Docs/reference verification, native drift/audit inventory, migration-directory check and final diff check passed.
notes: Local source changes only. No staging, commit, push, deployment or app distribution.
Bundle bytes, fixture request counts and thread placement are measured separately. No production load-time, broad simulator speedup or physical-device performance claim is made.

Automatic approval review rejected preview setup because it can provision external resources, mutate preview database/credentials and persist environment state. Authenticated route/API benchmarking requires approval for that isolated environment.

The next slice is repeated authenticated cold/warm route measurement, median/p95 API timings and physical iPhone 16 Pro Release traces with realistic photos. The summary.md file in this folder contains all route numbers and repeatable commands.
